title: Most people feel overwhelmed by the news, and it is easy to see why.
body:
We are drowning in headlines. Between the constant alerts on our phones and the endless scroll of social feeds, it has become nearly impossible to find the stories that actually impact our lives. The problem is not that there is too much news. The problem is that there is too much noise.

Being informed does not mean reading everything. It means reading what matters to you. When we rely on generic news feeds, we are served a diet of whatever is trending, regardless of whether it is relevant to our careers, our communities, or our personal interests. This creates a false sense of being informed while leaving us missing the details that actually shape our day.

Personalisation is not about building an echo chamber. It is about filtering out the clutter so you can focus on the signal. When technology works correctly, it acts as a curator rather than a gatekeeper. It helps you cut through the static to find the insights you need to make better decisions.

True intelligence is knowing where to direct your attention. We are building Headlinne to make that process simpler, cleaner, and more intentional.
